approach: Two slices that share only the redirect route. Destination safety: a pure host-rules module, used by URL validation on create and again when a link is resolved. Device analytics: schema first, then classify at the route, record, aggregate, including the split between automated and other traffic. Tests are written from the acceptance criteria in parallel with the code.

tasks.title: Migration: device_class on click_events
tasks.description: Add migration 003 with a not-null device_class column defaulting to 'unknown' and restricted to the five classes.

tasks.title: Host rules and destination validation
tasks.description: A module that decides whether a host is internal (address ranges in any notation, localhost, single-label and internal-suffix names) or on the denylist, and its use in destination URL validation.

tasks.title: DENIED_HOSTS configuration
tasks.description: Parse and validate the comma-separated denylist at startup.

tasks.title: Enforce the destination rules on redirect
tasks.description: Re-check the stored destination when a link is resolved and answer with a link_blocked error; wire the denylist into the link service.

tasks.title: Classify the device and record it with each click
tasks.description: Reduce the User-Agent header to a device class at the redirect route and store only the class with the click event.

tasks.title: Device breakdown in statistics, with bot and non-bot totals
tasks.description: Report clicks per device class in a fixed order, plus botClicks and nonBotClicks, leaving totalClicks unchanged.

tasks.title: Tests for destination safety
tasks.description: Rule tests covering every address range and notation, and API tests for create and for redirect after the denylist changes.

tasks.title: Tests for device analytics
tasks.description: Classification tests with real User-Agent strings, statistics tests for the breakdown and the bot split, and a test that the header is never stored.

tasks.title: Update the README and the OpenAPI contract
tasks.description: Document the destination rules and their limits, the new setting, the statistics fields and what is and is not stored.
